lines_of_business: Not listed by product; site-of-service criteria do not apply to Indian Health Services facilities
effective_or_revised: Effective Jul. 1, 2026; last revised Jun. 8, 2026; replaces 7.01.25 (BCBSA ref 7.01.25)
sections_in_order: Policy Coverage Criteria (Site of Service table; procedure tables)
criteria_location: Policy Coverage Criteria pp.2-6 (two stacked tables: site of service, then procedure criteria). Documentation Requirements p.7. Definitions p.9-10.
procedures_covered: SCS trial and permanent (standard and high-frequency)
Site of service for elective surgery (ASC vs hospital outpatient vs inpatient)
Replacement of functioning standard SCS with HF

logic.top_level: pathways (site of service; SCS; DRG; replacement; investigational) in a two-column table
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Investigational' row lists other situations: central deafferentation, nociceptive pain, CLI, refractory angina, pelvic pain, cancer pain, heart failure. Site of service: hospital outpatient allowed if no ASC within 30 miles or a listed high-risk condition.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Replacement 'only a small subset' when device not working/broken OR condition changed so processor inadequate. HF replacement of functioning standard SCS not medically necessary.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Medically necessary sites of service ... may be considered medically necessary if there is no access to an ambulatory surgical center due to one of the following criteria ... OR The individual has a clinical condition which puts them at increased risk
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Nested bullets with an OR at table-cell level; extracted text loses which list the 'OR' joins

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Replacement ... when: The stimulator is not working or is broken OR Replacement is needed because the individual's condition has changed
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'in only a small subset of individuals' is non-operational

requirement_kinds.quote: Other treatment modalities (pharmacological, surgical, psychological, or physical, if applicable) have failed, or are judged to be unsuitable or contraindicated

severe and chronic neuropathic pain of the trunk or limbs resulting from actual damage to peripheral nerves (such as failed lumbar back surgery syndrome, complex regional pain syndrome, arachnoiditis, phantom limb/stump pain, peripheral neuropathy, or painful diabetic neuropathy)
Member has obtained clearance by a licensed psychologist, psychiatrist, or other licensed mental health professional
demonstration of at least a 50% reduction in pain with at least a 3-day trial of temporary spinal cord stimulation
There is no qualifying ASC within 30 miles ... individual is aged 18 or younger ... ASA classification III or higher
Relevant history and physical showing that the individual has severe and chronic neuropathic pain ...
Morbid obesity (BMI greater than or equal to 50); COPD (FEV1 less than 50%); MELD Score greater than 8; recent MI (less than 3 months)

thresholds.quote: at least a 50% reduction in pain
BMI greater than or equal to 50
Recent history of myocardial infarction (MI) (less than 3 months)

time_windows.quote: at least a 3-day trial of temporary spinal cord stimulation
drug eluting stent placed less than 1 year or angioplasty less than 90 days

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed only; no mapping to SCS vs DRG

external_dependencies.quote: 11.01.525 Site of Service Ambulatory Service Center (ASC) Select Surgical Procedures

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Placement of a spinal cord stimulator is only appropriate for the treatment of neuropathic pain.
Nociceptive pain happens after tissue in the body has been damaged or is inflamed.
3 or more drugs to control blood pressure

vague_terms.quote: clearance by a licensed psychologist, psychiatrist, or other licensed mental health professional
in only a small subset of individuals
(this list may not be all inclusive)

extraction_hazards: Two-column table: left column row header, right column criteria; pdftotext interleaves cells and bullet markers
Site-of-service table repeats headers at each page ('Site of Service for / Medical Necessity')
Footnote asterisks (*, **, ***) define terms below the table
Navigation icon glyph appears at page bottoms
Table rows split across pages mid-bullet
Related Information includes anatomic lead levels (not criteria)
interesting_structures: Site-of-service medical necessity bundled with clinical criteria (ASC preferred)
Clinical risk checklist with numeric thresholds for hospital outpatient site
Trial length of at least 3 days

fit_to_tree.why: Clinical criteria are a simple ALL list; the site-of-service table adds a second tree (OR of access barriers and clinical risks, with numeric thresholds) mixed into the same table.
